name: Abiezer
overview: Abiezer, also known as Jeezer, is recognized in Scripture as the progenitor of the Abiezrites, a family within the tribe of Manasseh (Numbers 26:30; Joshua 17:2). The name Abiezer also identifies a notable warrior among David's mighty men, highlighting his role as one of David's heroes (2 Samuel 23:27; 1 Chronicles 27:12). Additionally, the region of Abiezer is referenced during the time of Gideon, illustrating its historical and tribal significance in Israel's narrative (Judges 6:34; Judges 8:2).
